scope: Descriptive retrospective sensitivity on already examined history. No new holdout, prospective observations, tuning or inferential confidence interval.
question: Along a common one-way fee and adverse-slippage multiplier, where does 20-session momentum change rank against passive BTC/cash or buy-and-hold?
books: Reuse the admitted causal features, fixed training median entropy and expanding annual passive allocations. All accounts start in cash once, trade fractional spot BTC at the first trade-bearing minute open at or after 00:05 UTC after the completed-close decision, then carry cash and units across folds. USD cash earns zero. Mark at closing prices with no terminal liquidation.

cost_path.units: One-way basis points per fill. Slippage is adverse to the quote; apply fees on filled notional to all traded accounts. Simulate all five books at every cost, including refinements.

criteria.passive_sharpe: Primary: pooled net daily-return Sharpe(momentum) minus Sharpe(passive BTC/cash), sample SD, sqrt(365), zero cash rate.
criteria.passive_wealth: Pooled closing USD wealth(momentum) minus wealth(passive BTC/cash).
criteria.hold_wealth: Pooled closing USD wealth(momentum) minus wealth(buy-and-hold).

annual: Retain five calendar-fold and pooled metrics for all five accounts on the full coarse grid. Each annual return uses the preceding December close (initial cash for 2020); daily returns, Sharpe, turnover and charges use that fold's entries. Annual endpoints carry earlier compounding. Only pooled differences are refined.

search.grid: Use i/20 for integers 0 through 40. Inspect adjacent sampled differences before refinement, retaining all samples; never join a bracket across an undefined statistic.
search.equality: Absolute difference at or below the corresponding zero tolerance is a sampled equality within tolerance. Distinguish isolated hits including endpoints and runs of adjacent such samples; neither certifies an exact mathematical root or a continuum of roots.
search.near_flat: Flag adjacent defined coarse samples whose absolute difference in criterion values is at most its zero tolerance, including near-flat nonzero regions.
search.refine: Bisect each adjacent, strictly opposite-sign bracket in increasing lambda order, in the declared criterion order. Cache full simulations by multiplier. Stop on sampled equality or width <= 0.0001; report midpoint of final bracket as a descriptive estimate with both checked endpoint signs. Record undefined and work-limited refinements explicitly. Make no global monotonicity assumption; same-sign samples cannot exclude intervening roots.

verification: Compare anchor ledgers and full pooled/annual metrics to the original gross, base and double_cost records at the existing reproduction tolerances. Verify execution chronology and portfolio accounting independently. Use independent synthetic sign-change, flat, equality, no-crossing, undefined and exhaustion fixtures. Retain provenance, output hashes and failures.
